{{Top}}
'''Sensor towers''' were stationary structures used by the [[Naddist]] [[Naddist army|army]] during the [[Battle of Iziz|Battle of]] [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] to spy on and report anything happening in their vicinity.

Arrays were found next to [[Iziz defense tower|Defense towers]], and both were constructed along the walls of Iziz, [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] only established city.
